description:
Give the git module one object reader that serves any number of reads through one `git cat-file --batch` process, and one presence check that serves any number of names through one `--batch-check` process.

## Background

- Readers that need objects use libgit2 today: storage reads at a commit (`crates/jit/src/storage/json.rs:1474-1530`), document show and diff (`read_file_from_git`, `crates/jit/src/commands/document.rs:848-862`), snapshot export (`read_from_git`, `crates/jit/src/commands/snapshot.rs:138-172`) and the asset presence check (`check_asset_in_git`, `crates/jit/src/commands/document.rs:1912-1927`). The archive planner starts three processes per pinned document (`inventory_issues_pinned_evidence`, `crates/jit/src/commands/archive.rs:90-105`).
- Snapshot export learns which assets to read only after reading the documents that cite them, so a reader must accept requests after it has answered earlier ones.
- `git cat-file --batch` without `--buffer` flushes each answer before reading the next request line, accepts names such as `<rev>:<path>` and `<rev>^{commit}`, and answers `<name> missing` for an absent object.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `GitCheckout::object_reader()` starts one `cat-file --batch` process that answers reads until it is dropped. Each read returns the object's id, type and bytes, or absent when git reports the name missing; bytes holding NUL and newline round-trip.
- [hard] REQ-02: `GitCheckout::object_types(names)` starts one `cat-file --batch-check` process and returns each name's object type, or absent.
- [hard] REQ-03: A name containing a newline is rejected with the module's invalid-path error before git sees it.
- [hard] REQ-04: The behaviour suite covers a blob, a tree, a missing path, an unresolvable revision, binary bytes and a missing executable, and counts one process per reader or presence call.

## Notes

- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: Object reader and presence check in the git module
